outcome: Total cost of care from surgery to infant discharge
cohort: 78 patients who underwent prenatal open neural tube defect (ONTD) repair, using either the open-hysterotomy or the fetoscopic approach
finding: Fetoscopic repair of ONTD, compared to open-hysterotomy repair, reduces the incidence of Cesarean section and preterm delivery with no significant difference in total costs of care from surgery to infant discharge.
mod_finding: Fewer women in the fetoscopic repair group underwent Cesarean section compared to the open repair group (53% vs 100%, P < 0.001).
gest_age: Median gestational age at birth was significantly higher in the fetoscopic repair group compared to the open repair group (38.1 weeks vs 35.7 weeks, P < 0.001)
